aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the primary change and reduces a full Doojin Test YK validation report to drop-test method data.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly includes Method Manual instead of new vendor Doojin/Test YK material.
Method Auto/Manual are outcome conditions, not the primary comparison factor.
Major outcomes are omitted: visual, decap, tension, function, and decision.
Baseline/test grouping should be Normal YK vs Test YK under one validation context.
Evidence set is too narrow and includes row 59 without context here.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Normal YK vs Test YK 161014 new vendor Doojin.
Use Auto/Manual only within drop-test outcome details.
Add outcomes for sub-line visual, decap MG-S-A/B, decap Yoke, tension, function, and drop tests.
Judge overall result from report decision: material can be used if all outcomes support it.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations are insufficient; each outcome needs direct row citations plus title, purpose, and decision rows.
